```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

**Status: EXPLORATORY.** Carries question R5 ("What did the symbiosis cost the neighbor?"). It is not
among the pre-specified confirmatory tests, and it uses all 30 mixed-stand pots rather than a
randomized fava manipulation. Fava roots were never stained, so fava's own colonization is
unmeasured: the figure relates fava *performance* to *wheat's* randomized inoculation treatment.

**Encoding (same in every figure).** Blue = wheat/ fava intercrop; filled box = inoculated wheat,
open box = sterile wheat.

```{r libs}
library(tidyverse)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
source("../fig_style.R")

inter <- readRDS("../wheat_audited.rds") %>% filter(Poly == "Inter")
stopifnot(nrow(inter) == 30, all(table(inter$Inoc, inter$Water) == 5),
          identical(levels(inter$Inoc), c("Inoc", "Strl")), all(inter$Num_fava == 1))
```

# Model and effect sizes

One fava plant per pot, so per-pot and per-plant biomass are the same number. The model is a single
`log(fava) ~ Inoc * Water` fit to all 30 pots (no subset models), and the effect in each water level
is conditioned inside it. Variance is homogeneous across the six cells (Levene below), so no variance
structure is needed.

```{r model}
lev_p <- car::leveneTest(log(fava_npp) ~ interaction(Inoc, Water), data = inter, center = median)[1, "Pr(>F)"]
m <- lm(log(fava_npp) ~ Inoc * Water, data = inter)
p_iw <- car::Anova(m, type = 2)["Inoc:Water", "Pr(>F)"]
cat(sprintf("Levene (6 cells): p = %.2f | Inoc:Water interaction: p = %.2g\n", lev_p, p_iw))

eff <- emmeans(m, ~ Inoc | Water) %>%
  contrast("pairwise", by = "Water", adjust = "none") %>%       # Inoc - Strl
  summary(infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)) %>% as.data.frame()
stopifnot(all(eff$contrast == "Inoc - Strl"))
eff <- eff %>% transmute(Water = factor(Water, levels(inter$Water)),
                         pct = (exp(estimate) - 1) * 100,
                         lo = (exp(lower.CL) - 1) * 100, hi = (exp(upper.CL) - 1) * 100, p = p.value)
fm <- function(x) gsub("-", "\u2212", sprintf("%+.0f", x), fixed = TRUE)   # signed, with a true minus sign
knitr::kable(eff %>% mutate(across(c(pct, lo, hi), ~ round(.x, 1)), p = signif(p, 3)),
             caption = "EXPLORATORY - Inoc - Strl effect on fava biomass, % change (unadjusted 95% CI)")
```

# Figure 3

```{r figure, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=5, dpi=150}
col <- pal_poly[["Inter"]]

# one bracket per water level spanning the inoculated and sterile boxes, labeled with the
# unadjusted p-value for that contrast (EXPLORATORY). Box centers sit at +/- 0.175 (dodge 0.7).
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 1e-4, "p < 0.0001", paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 2)))
tops <- inter %>% group_by(Water) %>% summarise(top = max(fava_npp), .groups = "drop")
brk <- eff %>% left_join(tops, by = "Water") %>%
  mutate(x = as.numeric(Water), xmin = x - 0.175, xmax = x + 0.175,
         y = top + 0.55, tick = 0.3, label = fmt_p(p))
p_int <- ifelse(p_iw < 1e-4, "< 0.0001", paste("=", signif(p_iw, 2)))
fig3 <- ggplot(inter, aes(x = Water, y = fava_npp, group = interaction(Water, Inoc))) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Inoc), color = col, linewidth = 0.7, width = 0.55,
               position = position_dodge(0.7), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Inoc), color = col, size = 2.2, stroke = 0.9, fill = NA,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = 0.7, seed = 1)) +
  geom_segment(data = brk, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(data = brk, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = y, yend = y - tick), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(data = brk, aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y - tick), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = brk, aes(x = x, y = y + 0.15, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            vjust = 0, size = 3.6, color = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Inoc = scales::alpha(col, 0.45), Strl = "white"), labels = inoc_lab) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shp_inoc, guide = "none") +   # box fill already carries inoculation
  scale_x_discrete(labels = water_lab) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(inter$fava_npp) * 1.2)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = col))) +
  labs(title = "AMF-wheat symbiosis reduces fava competitiveness",
       subtitle = paste0("Inoculation x water: p ", p_int),
       x = NULL, y = "Fava biomass per plant (g)") +
  theme_ms() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 3)),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 8)),
        plot.title.position = "plot")
print(fig3)

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("figures/Fig3_FavaSuppression.pdf", fig3, width = 7.5, height = 5)
ggsave("figures/Fig3_FavaSuppression.png", fig3, width = 7.5, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Proposed caption

> **Figure 3. Inoculated wheat suppressed its fava neighbor, except under severe drought
> (exploratory).** Fava biomass per plant (one fava per pot) in the 30 wheat/ fava intercrop pots,
> by wheat inoculation (filled = inoculated, open = sterile) and water level (FC = field capacity).
> Boxes show the median and interquartile range, points are individual pots (n = 5 per cell); brackets give
> the unadjusted p-value for inoculated vs. sterile at each water level. From a
> single model fitted to all 30 pots, fava biomass with inoculated wheat relative to sterile wheat
> changed by `r fm(eff$pct[1])`% (95% CI `r fm(eff$lo[1])` to `r fm(eff$hi[1])`%) at control, `r fm(eff$pct[2])`% (`r fm(eff$lo[2])` to `r fm(eff$hi[2])`%) at
> moderate, and `r fm(eff$pct[3])`% (`r fm(eff$lo[3])` to `r fm(eff$hi[3])`%, no detectable change) at severe water (unadjusted CIs); the
> inoculation x water interaction is p `r ifelse(p_iw < 1e-4, "< 0.0001", paste("=", signif(p_iw, 2)))`. Fava roots were not stained, so the
> figure shows fava performance in relation to wheat's randomized inoculation treatment, not fava's
> own colonization. This analysis is exploratory and was not among the pre-specified tests.

## Notes for the Results text

* **Robustness already on file.** `06_Exploratory.Rmd` found one Bonferroni-significant outlier pot;
  removing it strengthened the result, and a Kruskal-Wallis test across the six groups agreed.
  Report these in the text or appendix, not in the figure.
* **Reading the severe-drought cell.** The effect there is small with a CI that spans zero. Read it
  as "no detectable suppression", and not as "facilitation".
